cite.locator: p. 23, Community Property States, "If you and your spouse lived in a community property state, you must usually follow state law to determine what is community income and what is separate income. For details, see Form 8958 and Pub. 555"

project.form: Community income on a married head of household return in a community property state (Form 8958; Pub. 555)
project.remedy: A married person filing as head of household who lived in a community property state may have to report community income under state law; Form 8958 and the community property rules of Pub. 555 are outside this tool.

cite.locator: p. 9, Temporary absences, "It must be reasonable to assume the absent person will return to the home after the temporary absence. You must continue to keep up the home during the absence."

project.form: Temporary absences for head of household (Pub. 501)
project.remedy: For head of household, an absence counts as time lived with you only if it was reasonable to assume the absent person would return and you kept up the home; the time the person who would qualify you lived with you must be recounted under that rule, which this tool does not do.
